name: Effect: Potion of Living Light
text: Your skin sheds an aura of bright light in a 20-foot emanation (and dim light for another 20 feet), even through your clothing and armor, for 1 hour. While glowing, you gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against darkness and shadow effects. You can Dismiss this effect, causing a flash of light that causes every creature in a 20-foot emanation to be Blinded for 1 round unless they succeed at a DC 27 Fortitude save save.
